newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan cultist gets 17 years for VX gas killing.
newsitem.headline: Japan cultist gets 17 years for VX gas killing.

text.p: A follower of the religious cult accused of the Tokyo subway gassing received a 17-year prison term on Tuesday for killing a businessman with VX nerve gas. Cult member Akira Yamagata, 31, admitted the killing and said the victim was targeted for execution by the cult as a spy.
He was found guilty of murder in the VX gas killing of the victim, an Osaka businessman, and the attempted murder of two other people between December 1994 and January 1995.

The sentence is the longest so far handed down to scores of Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect) followers to face trial and punishment for crimes that came to light after cult members were arrested for their roles in the March 1995 sarin gassing on the Tokyo subway, which killed 12 people.
Cult founder Shoko Asahara is on trial in 17 criminal cases including the Tokyo subway attack, but has yet to enter pleas in any of the cases.
